uiQualityFindings: The implementation covers most UI and business requirements with a user-friendly layout
there are important issues in code maintainability and accessibility that need addressing.
Lack of semantic HTML elements, such as using <header>, <footer>, <main> for better structure.
Missing alt text for images which are not provided.
Some component CSS styling could improve maintainability through BEM or CSS Modules.
No focus states for buttons, impacting accessibility and usability.
The overall structure could benefit from splitting into smaller, reusable components.
All sections outlined in the acceptance criteria are present.
The design is visually appealing and uses the brand palette effectively.
Responsiveness is partially addressed but needs improvements for smaller devices.
Load time should be validated since it is a critical aspect of user experience.
